note: R6 (6.0.0-snapshot1) is pre-release; most production FHIR servers implement R4 (4.0.1). R6 does not carry numeric FMM levels - standards_status (normative/trial-use/informative) is the closest analog in this snapshot.

resources.name: Account
resources.description: A financial tool for tracking value accrued for a particular purpose.

resources.name: ActivityDefinition
resources.description: This resource allows for the definition of some activity to be performed, independent of a particular patient, practitioner, or other performance context.

resources.name: ActorDefinition
resources.description: The ActorDefinition resource is used to describe an actor - a human or an application that plays a role in data exchange, and that may have obligations associated with the role the actor plays.

resources.name: AdministrableProductDefinition
resources.description: A medicinal product in the final form which is suitable for administering to a patient (after any mixing of multiple components, dissolution etc.

resources.name: AdverseEvent
resources.description: An event (i.e.

resources.name: AllergyIntolerance
resources.description: Risk of harmful or undesirable, physiological response which is unique to an individual and associated with exposure to a substance.

resources.name: Appointment
resources.description: A booking of a healthcare event among patient(s), practitioner(s), related person(s) and/or device(s) for a specific date/time.

resources.name: AppointmentResponse
resources.description: A reply to an appointment request for a patient and/or practitioner(s), such as a confirmation or rejection.

resources.name: ArtifactAssessment
resources.description: This Resource provides one or more comments, classifiers or ratings about a Resource and supports attribution and rights management metadata for the added content.

resources.name: AuditEvent
resources.description: A record of an event relevant for purposes such as operations, privacy, security, maintenance, and performance analysis.

resources.name: Basic
resources.description: Basic is used for handling concepts not yet defined in FHIR, narrative-only resources that don't map to an existing resource, and custom resources not appropriate for inclusion in the FHIR specification.

resources.name: Binary
resources.description: A resource that represents the data of a single raw artifact as digital content accessible in its native format.

resources.name: BiologicallyDerivedProduct
resources.description: A biological material originating from a biological entity intended to be transplanted or infused into another (possibly the same) biological entity.

resources.name: BodyStructure
resources.description: Record details about an anatomical structure.

resources.name: Bundle
resources.description: A container for a collection of resources.

resources.name: CanonicalResource
resources.description: Common Interface declaration for conformance and knowledge artifact resources.

resources.name: CapabilityStatement
resources.description: A Capability Statement documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Server or Client for a particular version of FHIR that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server implementation.

resources.name: CarePlan
resources.description: Describes the intention of how one or more practitioners intend to deliver care for a particular patient, group or community for a period of time, possibly limited to care for a specific condition or set of conditions.

resources.name: CareTeam
resources.description: The Care Team includes all the people, organizations, and care teams who participate or plan to participate in the coordination and delivery of care.

resources.name: Claim
resources.description: A provider issued list of professional services and products which have been provided, or are to be provided, to a patient which is sent to an insurer for reimbursement.

resources.name: ClaimResponse
resources.description: This resource provides the adjudication details from the processing of a Claim resource.

resources.name: ClinicalUseDefinition
resources.description: A single issue - either an indication, contraindication, interaction, undesirable effect or warning for a medicinal product, medication, device or procedure.

resources.name: CodeSystem
resources.description: The CodeSystem resource is used to declare the existence of and describe a code system or code system supplement and its key properties, and optionally define a part or all of its content.

resources.name: Communication
resources.description: A clinical or business level record of information being transmitted or shared; e.g.

resources.name: CommunicationRequest
resources.description: A request to convey information from a sender to a recipient.

resources.name: CompartmentDefinition
resources.description: A compartment definition that defines how resources are accessed on a server.

resources.name: Composition
resources.description: Composition provides the structural backbone for assembling a set of healthcare-related information into a single logical package that provides a single coherent statement of meaning, establishes its own context and has traceability to the author who is making the statement.

resources.name: ConceptMap
resources.description: A statement of relationships from one set of concepts to one or more other concepts - either concepts in code systems, or data element/data element concepts, or classes in class models.

resources.name: Condition
resources.description: A clinical condition, problem, diagnosis, or other event, situation, issue, or clinical concept that has risen to a level of concern.

resources.name: Consent
resources.description: A record of a healthcare consumer’s  choices  or choices made on their behalf by a third party, which permits or denies identified recipient(s) or recipient role(s) to perform one or more actions within a given policy context, for specific purposes and periods of time.

resources.name: Coverage
resources.description: Financial instrument which may be used to reimburse or pay for health care products and services.

resources.name: CoverageEligibilityRequest
resources.description: The CoverageEligibilityRequest provides patient and insurance coverage information to an insurer for them to respond, in the form of an CoverageEligibilityResponse, with information regarding whether the stated coverage is valid and in-force and optionally to provide the insurance details of the pol

resources.name: CoverageEligibilityResponse
resources.description: This resource provides eligibility and plan details from the processing of an CoverageEligibilityRequest resource.

resources.name: DetectedIssue
resources.description: Indicates an actual or potential clinical issue with or between one or more active or proposed clinical actions for a patient; e.g.

resources.name: Device
resources.description: This resource describes the properties (regulated, has real time clock, etc.), administrative (manufacturer name, model number, serial number, firmware, etc.), and type (knee replacement, blood pressure cuff, MRI, etc.) of a physical unit (these values do not change much within a given module, for e

resources.name: DeviceAlert
resources.description: Describes a physiological or technical alert condition report originated by a device.

resources.name: DeviceAssociation
resources.description: A record of association of a device.

resources.name: DeviceDefinition
resources.description: This is a specialized resource that defines the characteristics and capabilities of a device.

resources.name: DeviceMetric
resources.description: Describes a measurement, calculation or setting capability of a device.

resources.name: DeviceRequest
resources.description: Represents a request a device to be provided to a specific patient.

resources.name: DiagnosticReport
resources.description: The findings and interpretation of diagnostic tests performed on patients, groups of patients, products, substances, devices, and locations, and/or specimens derived from these.

resources.name: DocumentReference
resources.description: A reference to a document of any kind for any purpose.

resources.name: DomainResource
resources.description: A resource that includes narrative, extensions, and contained resources.

resources.name: Encounter
resources.description: An interaction between healthcare provider(s), and/or patient(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of patient(s).

resources.name: Endpoint
resources.description: The technical details of an endpoint that can be used for electronic services, such as for web services providing XDS.b, a REST endpoint for another FHIR server, or a s/Mime email address.

resources.name: EpisodeOfCare
resources.description: An association between a patient and an organization / healthcare provider(s) during which time encounters may occur.

resources.name: EventDefinition
resources.description: The EventDefinition resource provides a reusable description of when a particular event can occur.

resources.name: Evidence
resources.description: The Evidence Resource provides a machine-interpretable expression of an evidence concept including the evidence variables (e.g., population, exposures/interventions, comparators, outcomes, measured variables, confounding variables), the statistics, and the certainty of this evidence.

resources.name: EvidenceVariable
resources.description: The EvidenceVariable resource describes an element that knowledge (Evidence) is about.

resources.name: ExampleScenario
resources.description: A walkthrough of a workflow showing the interaction between systems and the instances shared, possibly including the evolution of instances over time.

resources.name: ExplanationOfBenefit
resources.description: This resource provides: the claim details; adjudication details from the processing of a Claim; and optionally account balance information, for informing the subscriber of the benefits provided.

resources.name: FamilyMemberHistory
resources.description: Significant health conditions for a person related to the patient relevant in the context of care for the patient.

resources.name: Flag
resources.description: Prospective warnings of potential issues when providing care to the patient.

resources.name: Goal
resources.description: Describes the intended objective(s) for a patient, group, or organizational care.

resources.name: Group
resources.description: Represents a defined collection of entities that may be discussed or acted upon collectively but which are not typically expected to act collectively.

resources.name: GuidanceResponse
resources.description: A guidance response is the formal response to a guidance request, including any output parameters returned by the evaluation, as well as the description of any proposed actions to be taken.

resources.name: HealthcareService
resources.description: The details of a healthcare service available at a location or in a catalog.

resources.name: ImagingSelection
resources.description: A selection of DICOM SOP instances within a single DICOM Study and Series.

resources.name: ImagingStudy
resources.description: Representation of the content produced in a DICOM imaging study.

resources.name: Immunization
resources.description: Describes the event of a patient being administered a vaccine or a record of an immunization as reported by a patient, a clinician or another party.

resources.name: ImplementationGuide
resources.description: A set of rules of how a particular interoperability or standards problem is solved - typically through the use of FHIR resources.

resources.name: Ingredient
resources.description: An ingredient of a manufactured item or pharmaceutical product.

resources.name: Library
resources.description: The Library resource is a general-purpose container for knowledge artifact definitions.

resources.name: List
resources.description: A List is a curated collection of resources, for things such as problem lists, allergy lists, facility list, organization list, etc.

resources.name: Location
resources.description: Details and position information for a place where services are provided and resources and participants may be stored, found, contained, or accommodated.

resources.name: ManufacturedItemDefinition
resources.description: The definition and characteristics of a medicinal manufactured item, such as a tablet or capsule, as contained in a packaged medicinal product.

resources.name: Measure
resources.description: The Measure resource provides the definition of a quality measure.

resources.name: MeasureReport
resources.description: The MeasureReport resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation.

resources.name: Medication
resources.description: This resource is primarily used for the identification and definition of a medication, including ingredients, for the purposes of prescribing, dispensing, and administering a medication as well as for making statements about medication use.

resources.name: MedicationAdministration
resources.description: Describes the event of a patient consuming or otherwise being administered a medication.

resources.name: MedicationDispense
resources.description: Indicates that a medication product is to be or has been dispensed for a named person/patient.

resources.name: MedicationRequest
resources.description: An order or request for both supply of the medication and the instructions for administration of the medication to a patient.

resources.name: MedicationStatement
resources.description: A record of a medication consumed by a patient.

resources.name: MedicinalProductDefinition
resources.description: Detailed definition of a medicinal product, typically for uses other than direct patient care (e.g.

resources.name: MessageDefinition
resources.description: Defines the characteristics of a message that can be shared between systems, including the type of event that initiates the message, the content to be transmitted and what response(s), if any, are permitted.

resources.name: MessageHeader
resources.description: The header for a message exchange that is either requesting or responding to an action.

resources.name: MetadataResource
resources.description: Common Interface declaration for conformance and knowledge artifact resources.

resources.name: NamingSystem
resources.description: A curated namespace that issues unique symbols within that namespace for the identification of concepts, people, devices, etc.

resources.name: NutritionIntake
resources.description: A record of intake by a patient.

resources.name: NutritionOrder
resources.description: A request to supply a diet, formula feeding (enteral) or oral nutritional supplement to an individual or group.

resources.name: NutritionProduct
resources.description: A food or supplement that is consumed by patients.

resources.name: Observation
resources.description: Measurements and simple assertions made about a patient, device or other subject.

resources.name: ObservationDefinition
resources.description: Set of definitional characteristics for a kind of observation or measurement produced or consumed by an orderable health care service.

resources.name: OperationDefinition
resources.description: A formal computable definition of an operation (on the RESTful interface) or a named query (using the search interaction).

resources.name: OperationOutcome
resources.description: A collection of error, warning, or information messages that result from a system action.

resources.name: Organization
resources.description: A formally or informally recognized grouping of people or organizations formed for the purpose of achieving some form of collective action.

resources.name: OrganizationAffiliation
resources.description: Defines an affiliation/assotiation/relationship between 2 distinct organizations, that is not a part-of relationship/sub-division relationship.

resources.name: PackagedProductDefinition
resources.description: A medically related item or items, in a container or package.

resources.name: Parameters
resources.description: This resource is used to pass information into and back from an operation (whether invoked directly from REST or within a messaging environment).

resources.name: Patient
resources.description: Demographics and other administrative information about an individual or animal that is the subject of potential, past, current, or future health-related care, services, or processes.

resources.name: PaymentNotice
resources.description: This resource provides the status of the payment for goods and services rendered, and the request and response resource references.

resources.name: PaymentReconciliation
resources.description: This resource provides the details including amount of a payment and allocates the payment items being paid.

resources.name: Person
resources.description: Demographics and administrative information about a person independent of a specific health-related context.

resources.name: PlanDefinition
resources.description: This resource allows for the definition of various types of plans as a sharable, consumable, and executable artifact.

resources.name: Practitioner
resources.description: A person who is directly or indirectly involved in the provisioning of healthcare or related services.

resources.name: PractitionerRole
resources.description: A specific set of Roles/Locations/specialties/services that a practitioner may perform, or has performed at an organization during a period of time.

resources.name: Procedure
resources.description: An action that is or was performed on or for a patient, practitioner, device, organization, or location.

resources.name: Provenance
resources.description: Provenance of a resource is a record that describes entities and processes involved in producing and delivering or otherwise influencing that resource.

resources.name: Questionnaire
resources.description: A structured set of questions intended to guide the collection of answers from end-users.

resources.name: QuestionnaireResponse
resources.description: A structured set of questions and their answers.

resources.name: RegulatedAuthorization
resources.description: Regulatory approval, clearance or licensing related to a regulated product, treatment, facility or activity that is cited in a guidance, regulation, rule or legislative act.

resources.name: RelatedPerson
resources.description: Information about a person that is involved in a patient's health or the care for a patient, but who is not the primary target of healthcare.

resources.name: RequestOrchestration
resources.description: A set of related requests that can be used to capture intended activities that have inter-dependencies such as "give this medication after that one".

resources.name: Requirements
resources.description: The Requirements resource is used to describe an actor - a human or an application that plays a role in data exchange, and that may have obligations associated with the role the actor plays.

resources.name: ResearchStudy
resources.description: A scientific study intended to increase health-related knowledge.

resources.name: ResearchSubject
resources.description: A ResearchSubject is a participant or object which is the recipient of investigative activities in a research study.

resources.name: Resource
resources.description: This is the base resource type for everything.

resources.name: RiskAssessment
resources.description: An assessment of the likely outcome(s) for a patient or other subject as well as the likelihood of each outcome.

resources.name: Schedule
resources.description: A container for slots of time that may be available for booking appointments.

resources.name: SearchParameter
resources.description: A search parameter that defines a named search item that can be used to search/filter on a resource.

resources.name: ServiceRequest
resources.description: A record of a request for service such as diagnostic investigations, treatments, or operations to be performed.

resources.name: Slot
resources.description: A slot of time on a schedule that may be available for booking appointments.

resources.name: Specimen
resources.description: A sample to be used for analysis.

resources.name: SpecimenDefinition
resources.description: A kind of specimen with associated set of requirements.

resources.name: StructureDefinition
resources.description: A definition of a FHIR structure.

resources.name: Subscription
resources.description: The subscription resource describes a particular client's request to be notified about a SubscriptionTopic.

resources.name: SubscriptionStatus
resources.description: The SubscriptionStatus resource describes the state of a Subscription during notifications.

resources.name: SubscriptionTopic
resources.description: Describes a stream of resource state changes identified by trigger criteria and annotated with labels useful to filter projections from this topic.

resources.name: Substance
resources.description: A homogeneous material with a definite composition.

resources.name: SubstanceDefinition
resources.description: The detailed description of a substance, typically at a level beyond what is used for prescribing.

resources.name: Task
resources.description: A task to be performed as a part of a workflow and the related information like inputs, outputs and execution progress.

resources.name: TerminologyCapabilities
resources.description: A TerminologyCapabilities resource documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Terminology Server that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server implementation.

resources.name: ValueSet
resources.description: A ValueSet resource instance specifies a set of codes drawn from one or more code systems, intended for use in a particular context.

resources.name: VisionPrescription
resources.description: An authorization for the provision of glasses and/or contact lenses to a patient.
